plugins.name: competition-analyzer-tracker
plugins.description: Competitive intelligence for Claude Code: discover competitors, compare pricing and features, analyze customer reviews and SEO evidence, create source-linked sales battlecards, and track meaningful changes with saved watchlists. Uses your Apify account and Khadin Akbar's Actors through the official Apify CLI. Existing exports work offline; recurring collection requires an authorized scheduler.
